ROOKIE ORIENTATION

THEY FALL.
YOU FIGHT BACK.

  1. Choose controls, targets and pace in the four-step setup. Number targets are single whole numbers. In typing, answer with digits only. Single letters are for Speak mode.
  2. Type: Switch to an English keyboard and turn off UniKey / Vietnamese input before playing. complete an unambiguous answer and it fires immediately. If it could be the start of a longer active target, the game waits briefly for the rest. Enter is an optional shortcut.
  3. Speak: allow microphone access and say a displayed number, letter name or word. Speak IPA cards as whole words. Stable interim words can attack early. Say several targets together to attack several monsters; each phrase is counted once.
  4. Answers hit the matching monster closest to the line. Partial character matches can damage one target; each position only counts once. Complete the remaining characters to defeat it.
  5. Five hearts. Every escaped monster costs one. Speaking has a smaller, slower swarm, a short grace period at the line, and freezes during microphone reconnection. Each 20-second wave picks up the pace. Pause anytime; hidden tabs pause automatically.

Speech depends on your browser’s recognition service and connection; it checks recognized words, not phoneme accuracy. No audio is saved by Inkfang. Best scores and custom questions stay on this browser.
